name: M5.ConditionalResidueCount.prefix_gcd_divisibility
statement: ∀ (T d : ℕ) (p q : List (Fin T)), (d ∣ M5.ConditionalResidueCount.selectedGcd T p q ↔ d ∣ T ∧ (∀ r ∈ p, d ∣ r.val) ∧ (∀ r ∈ q, d ∣ r.val))
queries: list gcd fold divisibility finite sum commutation
guidance: Prove by list induction that d divides prefixGcd exactly when it divides every selected residue, then unfold selectedGcd and gcd divisibility. The empty list uses gcd fold seed zero. Repeated residues are retained and allowed; no injectivity or positivity assumption is needed. Return tactic lines only without leading by; preserve exact target.
